text:
Run the xtask spec coverage tests automatically on any commit that changes BRIEF.md or docs/spec.toml, including direct the person running Athena commits made outside a job. Do this as a pre-push hook installed by setup.sh and as a CI check on main. When it refuses a commit, name each BRIEF.md heading or addendum that has no docs/spec.toml entry. Acceptance: (1) a test commit that adds a BRIEF.md section with no spec entry is refused, and the refusal names that section; (2) the same commit with a spec entry (mechanism none is allowed) passes; (3) a commit that touches neither file skips the check; (4) cargo test, clippy and fmt pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: A hand edit to BRIEF.md with no matching docs/spec.toml entries broke the spec coverage tests and got three jobs rejected
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: BRIEF.md, docs/spec.toml
